I was pleased to announce $9.34 million in federal funding for Nuestra Clínica del Valle through HRSA’s Health Center Program, which helps community health centers provide quality, affordable health care to underserved communities.

For more than 50 years, Nuestra Clínica del Valle has served families across Hidalgo and Starr Counties. With 11 locations, including clinics in Rio Grande City and Roma, Nuestra Clínica provides medical, dental, pharmacy, laboratory, nutrition and social services to approximately 25,000 patients each year.

These federal dollars help keep doctors, nurses and health professionals in our communities and ensure families can access the care they need close to home, regardless of their income or insurance status.

Thank you to CEO Lucy Torres, Clinic Coordinator Manuel Sepulveda, and all of the providers, nurses, staff and the entire Nuestra Clínica del Valle team for your continued commitment to families across the Rio Grande Valley. I’ll continue supporting federal investments in our community health centers and working to ensure South Texas receives the resources needed to provide quality health care for our families.
